criteria.text: New shares default 90 days instead of 30.
criteria.reason: Route-level test drives authenticated POST /agent-sessions/:id/shares without expiresAt and asserts both the returned and persisted expiry; the same test verifies the repository fallback.

criteria.text: purgeDueSnapshots purges only snapshots at least 30 days past expires_at or revoked_at; writes a content-free delete audit and deletes the shared_transcripts row in one transaction; recently expired and NULL/NULL rows survive; rollback leaves no partial audit.
The purge is idempotent and leaves source sessions and message raw bytes byte-identical after two purges, including against disposable Postgres.

The boot sweep and daily timer start exactly once only when VITEST is not true, RHYTHM_TRANSCRIPT_SHARE_PURGE_ENABLED is true, and dbClient is postgres; each false condition independently prevents startup.

No schema or column changes and no #1425 sharing UI/API, Flutter, route, reviewHash, publication, signing, attestation, migration, or batching work is included; the shared-transcripts controller may change only its existing default expiration from 30 to 90 days; rollout warns operators to count due rows before enabling and add SKIP LOCKED batches for a large backlog.
criteria.reason: Verification-gate must inspect the exact diff and run note; this is a patch-scope and rollout-handoff criterion rather than runtime behavior.
